title: Great table!
text: Great table!. I got this to use as part of a coffee table set up. This is very well packaged. Nothing was scratched. Comes with everything you need except a phillips screw driver. The alan wrench that come with the screws is a nice size with a long handle making it much easier to use in the close spaces. The step by step instructions are easy to follow EXCEPT you have to make sure you set out the table legs first because there are left and right sides. I didnt think that was so I just figured the shelves matched up with the holes. If you look closely there are a slight slant at the bottom of the legs..this is where you have to be careful to make sure those slants are all facing inwards. Once you got that, it is very easy to assemble. I love this table. It is sturdy, heavy and a nice dark chocolate wood with a nice wood pattern. I would definatly recommend this table for any use.
